import json,subprocess,math
for i,line in enumerate(open('items.jsonl'),1):
 r=json.loads(line)
 w,h=map(int,subprocess.check_output(['magick','identify','-format','%w %h',r['crop']]).decode().split())
 parts=[]
 for j in range(4):
  x=w*j//4; end=w*(j+1)//4
  p=f'zoom/{i:03}part{j}.png';parts.append(p)
  subprocess.run(['magick',r['crop'],'-crop',f'{end-x}x{h}+{x}+0','+repage','-resize','400%',p],check=True)
 subprocess.run(['magick',*parts,'-background','white','-gravity','west','-append',f'zoom/{i:03}panel.png'],check=True)
print('88 split enlargement panels created')

import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
answers[84]['slots']['3']='ъ'
answers[84]['confidence']['3']='low'
answers[84]['note']='Slot 3 has a detached left top flag and worn bowl/stem ink.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers:f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
checked=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(checked)==len(items)==88
assert [a['item_id'] for a in checked]==[r['item_id'] for r in items]
for r,a in zip(items,checked):
 expected={str(j) for j in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(a['slots'])==set(a['confidence'])==expected,(r['item_id'],'coverage')
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
c=collections.Counter(v for a in checked for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated: 88 JSON lines; exact input order; complete slot and confidence coverage.')
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in checked))
